title: Quantum Pong
tagline: Classic two-player Pong, with quantum gates that split, flip and teleport the ball.
description: Return the ball and get it past your opponent. Gates named after quantum operations appear on the field: H splits the ball in two, X and Z bounce it, SWAP teleports it. A dashed outline shows where the next gate will appear, so you can aim for it.

keyboard.p1: W / S to move, Space to pause
keyboard.p2: Up / Down to move, Enter to pause

how_to_play: Move your paddle to return the ball.
Score by getting the ball past the other paddle. First to 7 wins.
Hit the gates: H splits the ball, X and Z bounce it, SWAP teleports it.
Start (Space or Enter) pauses the game.
